task: binarna klasifikacia failure (APU predictive maintenance), dataset 046
preprocessing:
ColumnTransformer(transformers=[('categorical',
                                 OrdinalEncoder(categories=[['light', 'medium',
                                                             'heavy']]),
                                 ['class_duty']),
                                ('skewed',
                                 Pipeline(steps=[('imputer',
                                                  SimpleImputer(strategy='median')),
                                                 ('transform',
                                                  PowerTransformer(standardize=False)),
                                                 ('scaler', StandardScaler())]),
                                 ['filterDp', 'rms_vibration', 'serviceHours']),
                                ('other',
                                 Pipeline(steps=[('imputer',
                                                  SimpleImputer(strategy='median')),
                                                 ('scaler', StandardScaler())]),
                                 ['currentMotor', 'oilTemperature',
                                  'reservoir_pressure', 'Flowmeter',
                                  'dewpointDischarge']),
                                ('missing', MissingIndicator(features='all'),
                                 ['filterDp', 'rms_vibration'])])

threshold.rule: max F2 na out-of-fold predikciach 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold (train)

training_data.split: 80/20 po id_unit, stratifikacia podla failure jednotky, random_state=42 (2.1 A)
